moisture_pct.note: IFCT E028 white flesh 83.79+/-0.30; E029 pink flesh 81.22+/-0.45

water_activity.note: No guava freezing point found; generic fresh-produce aw range 0.970-0.996 from Chirife & Fontan (1982)

pH.note: FDA lists only 'Guava, canned' 3.37-4.10; no fresh guava entry

respiration.note: AH-66 Table 1: 34 (10 C), 74 (20 C); chapter range 8-60 (10 C), 18-130 (20 C). Ea fitted by Arrhenius to Table 1 values (53-56 kJ/mol across low/mid/high pairs)

storage_optimum.note: Mature-green/partially ripe: 2-3 weeks at 8-10 C (AH-66 guava chapter; also Cantwell 2001: 5-10 C, 2-3 weeks). ~7 days at 20 C. Ripe fruit ~1 week at 5-8 C. Chilling threshold 4.5 C from AH-66 chilling-injury table

ethylene.note: Climacteric; 1-20 uL/kg.h at 20 C varying with cultivar and ripeness (AH-66); ripening accelerated by ethylene. Chilled mature-green fruit show skin scald, pitting, failure to ripen

cut.note: respiration_x from KB generic mod_cut (USDA-AH66); 4 h = FDA Food Code 3-501.19 time-as-control limit
